simple.meaning: הָרַג (hârag) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to smite with deadly intent.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 167 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 4:8. Its contexts include birth, family, family line, death, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הָרַג (H2026).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: הָרַג (hârag) / H2026 is traced through Genesis 4:8, Genesis 4:14, Genesis 4:15, Genesis 4:23 as a generated source-based concept entry.
